description: This file is a Node.js script for generating plugin SDK facades and associated type maps. It imports several internal modules for formatting and writing output, processes command-line arguments, and orchestrates the generation process including file writing and status output.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine mode (--check or --write), ensuring exactly one mode is specified.

methods.name: generatePluginSdkFacades
methods.description: Main function that generates plugin SDK facade files and type maps based on constants and inputs.
